If a period is given, the formula would be energy_yield_kwh / (cap_mw*1000 * hours) * 100.

from: electrical_performance e JOIN plant_record r ON r.snapkey = e.snaplink JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie
check: SELECT r.snapkey, (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'grid'->>'harmonic_distortion_pct')::float AS thd FROM electrical_performance e JOIN plant_record r ON r.snapkey = e.snaplink JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie WHERE (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'grid'->>'harmonic_distortion_pct')::float < 5
note: elec_perf_snapshot->'grid'->>'harmonic_distortion_pct', percent (0-5). < 5 desirable.
